scenes.heading: Marketing yourself as a designer without cold pitching constantly

sents.d: Marketing yourself as a designer without cold pitching constantly
A strong portfolio and referral network reduce reliance on constant outreach.

Constantly cold-pitching potential clients is exhausting and often low-converting — building visibility through consistent portfolio sharing, case studies, and a referral network tends to produce steadier, warmer leads over time.

Publishing short case studies of completed projects (the challenge, your process, the result) on social platforms designers' target clients actually use does double duty: marketing and portfolio-building at once.
Asking satisfied clients directly for introductions to others who might need design work — rather than hoping they'll think to refer you — usually produces more referrals than waiting passively.

take: Share case studies and ask happy clients for introductions.
